key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:820C
name: read_block_through_dos
description: Calls a library routine through a function table entry, the dos read call, with two helper calls before and after it when a flag byte is set. It returns an unused byte.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8250
name: read_key_matching_string
description: Reads a key through a helper, echoes it through a formatting call with the referenced format text, and folds it to upper case when the character class table flags it. It returns the key once it appears in the zero-terminated string passed in.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8296
name: read_key_until_string_match
description: Reads a key through a helper while the string pointer sits on a zero byte, echoes it, folds its case by the class table, and advances through the string until the current byte matches the key. It returns the matched key.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:82B2
name: advance_string_until_key_match
description: Steps the string pointer forward, reads a key through the helper whenever the current byte is zero, echoes it, folds its case, and repeats until the key equals the current string byte. It returns that key.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:82B6
name: return_without_action
description: Returns straight away with no body and no library call. It does nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:82BC
name: bracket_step_with_global_helper
description: Calls a helper with the global variable, then a parameterless helper, then the global helper again. It is a small sequence that runs one step between two helper calls.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:82D4
name: compute_visible_row_count
description: Opens a library, finds the current task and reads a window pointer from it under a multitasking lock, then divides the space below the window's top by a font line height. It returns that row count, at least 8, or the fallback 23 when a structure pointer is missing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:838C
name: check_string_for_special_chars
description: Copies eight bytes from a global table into a local buffer, then scans the argument string and returns 1 if any of its characters appear in that set, or 0 at the terminator. The referenced text lists wildcard and punctuation characters, which matches the copied set.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:83C2
name: search_char_set_resume
description: Resumes a scan of the current string from a saved index, comparing each byte with the eight-byte set the caller passed on the stack. It returns 1 on the first match and 0 at the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:83C6
name: search_string_for_char_set
description: Scans the string from its start, comparing each byte with the eight-byte set passed on the stack. It returns 1 on the first match and 0 at the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:83CA
name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero immediately with no other work. It is referenced only through a pointer in the data, so it serves as a fixed hook.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8A80
name: call_exec_alloc_mem
description: Calls the exec library's memory allocation entry through the library base and returns nothing. A data-table handler and many routines reach it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8AC2
name: call_exec_free_mem
description: Calls the exec library's memory release entry through the library base and returns nothing. A data-table handler and many routines reach it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8AE0
name: allocate_memory_halving_size
description: Tries to allocate a block of the requested size and stores the pointer on success, returning 0. On failure it halves the size and retries, and once the size drops to 256 or below it reports a failure through a helper and returns 1.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8B00
name: retry_allocation_with_smaller_size
description: Halves the stored size and attempts an allocation at each step, returning 0 on success. Once the size would fall to 256 or below, it prints the fatal insufficient-memory message through a helper and returns 1.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8B24
name: forward_two_arguments
description: Passes its two arguments straight on to another routine and returns nothing. It is referenced from a data table, so it acts as a thin forwarding wrapper.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8B40
name: consume_bits_refill_buffer
description: Removes the given number of bits from a bit buffer by shifting it right. When the remaining bit count goes negative, it adds sixteen and loads the next 16-bit word from the input stream into the buffer, as a bit reader for the LZX-style decoder.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8BCA
name: read_bits_from_buffer
description: Captures the current bit buffer, consumes the requested number of bits through the bit reader, and returns the low bits of the captured value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8BF8
name: decode_eight_bit_huffman_symbol
description: Looks up a symbol in a table indexed by the low eight bits of the bit buffer. If the entry is an internal node, it walks a binary tree one bit at a time, then consumes the code length from a second table and returns the symbol.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8C56
name: decode_six_bit_huffman_symbol
description: Uses a six-bit lookup table, walking a binary tree for longer codes, then consumes the code length from a byte table and returns the symbol.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8CB0
name: reset_bit_buffer_from_input
description: Loads two 16-bit words from the input stream into the bit buffer, advances the input pointer past them, and sets the bit count to sixteen. It initialises the bit reader.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8CFE
name: copy_256_bytes_from_reader
description: Reads 256 bytes one at a time through a reader helper and stores them consecutively at the destination pointer. It fills a fixed-size block.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8D2E
name: read_bytes_and_sum
description: Reads a counted run of bytes through a helper, storing each one at the destination and accumulating a 16-bit total. The run length is the argument plus one, and the total is returned.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8D60
name: read_lzx_header_and_tables
description: Reads the LZX header fields from the bit stream, skipping a stored count, and allocates the decoding tables sized from the fields it reads. If allocation fails it prints the insufficient-memory message and exits. When the flag argument is 1 it checks a summed byte count and stops on a mismatch.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8F3A
name: count_newlines_in_string
description: Counts the newline characters in the zero-terminated text passed in and returns the total.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8F5C
name: exit_with_error_code_one
description: Calls a helper with the value one and returns nothing. It is the shared failure path that runs after an error message.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8F68
name: print_paged_text_lines
description: Prints text one line at a time, breaking it into pages of lines and calling a helper between pages. It checks a status flag after each line and stops early when the flag is set, printing a closing message in that case.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8FF0
name: combine_four_byte_digits
description: Folds four bytes into one 16-bit value by multiplying the running total by sixteen before adding each byte, so each byte acts as a base-16 digit. It returns the combined value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:9016
name: return_nothing_stub
description: Returns immediately with no body and no library call. It does nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:901E
name: run_once_then_set_flag
description: Checks a one-time flag in the state block. If it is still clear, it sets the flag and calls a helper with zero, so the initialisation runs only once.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:9084
name: compare_path_tails
description: Finds the final portion of each path after a slash or colon separator, passes the two portions to a comparison helper, and returns 1 when that helper reports a match. It returns 0 when the first path is empty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:90BC
name: check_path_final_component
description: Trims the given path back to its last slash or colon separator and passes the result to a helper. It returns 1 when the helper reports success, which it signals with a zero result, and 0 for an empty path.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:90E8
name: test_helper_result_zero
description: Calls a helper with no arguments and returns true when its result is zero. It is a boolean wrapper around that check.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:90FA
name: return_zero_success
description: Returns zero with no other work. It is referenced from several places as a fixed success result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:9102
name: check_path_ends_with_slash
description: Returns 1 when the zero-terminated path ends with a forward slash, otherwise 0. An empty string returns 0.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:9126
name: return_zero_without_effect
description: Returns zero immediately, with no other work. A single routine uses it as a fixed result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:9250
name: normalize_path_separators
description: Walks the zero-terminated path in place and replaces every backslash with a forward slash. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:926E
name: return_nothing_from_hook
description: Returns immediately without any work. It is reached only through a pointer in the data.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:9274
name: split_path_into_parts
description: Splits a path at its last slash or colon, copying the directory and device parts into the supplied buffers when they are present. Those buffers are cleared first.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:92CA
name: copy_path_remainder
description: Copies the tail of a path into a buffer, starting after the given index, or the whole string when the index is negative. When the index lands on a slash, it trims the buffer at the separator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:92E2
name: copy_path_tail_and_trim
description: Copies the portion of a path after a given index into the buffer, then cuts the buffer at the last slash before that point and at any colon boundary. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:9312
name: trim_path_parts_at_separators
description: Places terminators in the supplied directory and device buffers at the separator positions found by an earlier scan. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:933E
name: terminate_device_part_buffer
description: Writes a terminator into the output buffer that holds the device part when the path has a colon at the given position, clamping that position to the buffer length. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:9400
name: find_matching_list_entry
description: Walks a linked list of named entries and returns the first entry whose name matches the given text, optionally transforming each name by flag bits before comparing. It checks for a pending interrupt signal during the walk and returns the current entry if one arrives, or nothing when no entry matches.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:9424
name: find_matching_list_entry_local
description: Walks a linked list of named entries from a head pointer passed in, comparing names as its neighbour does, but writes transformed names into local buffers. It returns the first matching entry, or nothing when none matches.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:942E
name: find_first_entry_matching_name
description: Walks a linked list of named entries and returns the first entry for which a name check reports success, checking for a pending interrupt signal along the way. It returns nothing when the list is exhausted.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:94A6
name: scan_entries_with_name_filter
description: Applies a name check to the first list entry and then walks the following entries, skipping those that fail an optional filter and returning the first match. It stops early on an interrupt signal and returns nothing when the list is exhausted.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:94BC
name: scan_entries_after_interrupt_check
description: Checks for a pending interrupt signal first, then walks a linked list of named entries and returns the first entry whose name passes the check. It uses the same optional name transformation as its neighbours.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:94EA
name: search_entries_for_name
description: Walks a linked list of named entries, skipping entries that fail an optional filter and stopping on an interrupt signal, and returns the first entry whose name check passes. It returns nothing when no entry matches.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:94F2
name: return_zero_flag
description: Returns zero with no other work. Three callers use it as a fixed result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:9590
name: add_named_entry_optional_check
description: Allocates a new list entry sized for the given name, optionally rejecting duplicates first, then copies the name in, flags the entry and appends it to the list tail. It stores a status code: 0 for success, 1 when memory runs out, and 2 for a duplicate.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:95D4
name: add_entry_checking_duplicates
description: Checks the list for an existing entry with the same name, then allocates and appends a new named entry. It stores status 2 when a duplicate is found, 1 when allocation fails, and 0 on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:95DE
name: append_named_entry
description: Allocates a list entry sized for the name, copies the name into it, flags it and appends it to the list tail. It stores status 1 on allocation failure and 0 on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:9606
name: init_named_entry_and_append
description: Initialises a caller-supplied entry block by clearing its header, copying the name in, flagging it and appending it to the list tail. It stores status 0 on success, and status 1 when the list is in an inconsistent state.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:963A
name: link_entry_checked_tail
description: Links a new entry onto the tail of a list when the tail pointer is set. If the tail is missing, it prints the internal list error message, sets the status to 1 and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:966C
name: link_entry_to_list_tail
description: Appends an entry to the list tail and sets the status to 0. It assumes the tail pointer is valid.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B2A0
name: open_output_file_or_report
description: Attempts to open the output file named in the state block, and when that fails prints a 'can't open for output' message with the file name. It returns true when the open failed.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B324
name: close_output_file_if_open
description: Closes the output file handle stored in the state block when that handle is set. It does nothing otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B524
name: allocate_decoder_work_buffers
description: Allocates the decoder's work buffers: a table sized from a stored count, two blocks of 131072 bytes, a block sized from another stored value, two blocks of 32768 bytes and a block of 4096 bytes. On any failure it prints the insufficient-memory message and returns 1; otherwise it sets up the window pointers and returns 0.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B544
name: allocate_decoder_buffers_after_table
description: Allocates the same decoder buffers as its neighbour without the first table, returning 1 on any allocation failure. On success it sets up the window pointers and returns 0.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B560
name: allocate_decoder_buffers_from_window
description: Allocates the decoder buffers from the second 131072-byte block onward, then the table, two 32768-byte blocks and a 4096-byte block, and sets up the window pointers. It returns 1 on any allocation failure and 0 on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B57C
name: allocate_decoder_buffers_from_table
description: Allocates the decoder buffers starting with a table sized from a stored count, then two 32768-byte blocks and a 4096-byte block, and sets up the window pointers. It returns 1 on any allocation failure and 0 on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B59E
name: allocate_small_decoder_buffers
description: Allocates two 32768-byte blocks and a 4096-byte block, then sets up the window pointers. It returns 1 on any allocation failure and 0 on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B5BE
name: allocate_last_decoder_buffers
description: Allocates one 32768-byte block and a 4096-byte block, then sets up the window pointers. It returns 1 on any allocation failure and 0 on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B5D8
name: allocate_final_decoder_buffer
description: Allocates a 4096-byte block and fills a 768-byte table through a helper, then sets up the window pointers. It returns 1 on failure and 0 on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B5F0
name: init_decoder_table_and_window
description: Initialises a 768-byte table through a helper and, when that succeeds, sets the window pointers and marks the state ready. It returns true when the helper reported failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B60A
name: set_window_pointers_and_ready
description: Sets the two window pointers from the stored buffer addresses, calls two helpers, and marks the decoder state ready. It returns 0.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B638
name: free_decoder_work_buffers
description: Frees each decoder work buffer that is set, passing the matching size for each one, and clears its pointer. It also releases the 768-byte table through a helper and clears the ready flag.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B762
name: free_optional_buffer_if_set
description: Frees a buffer stored in the state block when it is set, passing a size taken from a stored field, and then clears the pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B77A
name: flush_pending_output_span
description: When the current output position is below the stored limit, writes the pending span through a helper and reports a failure through another helper if that write fails. It then records the current position as the new mark.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B89E
name: write_block_and_count_bytes
description: Writes a block of bytes through a helper unless a stored flag lets an earlier check decide the result. On a complete write it adds the length to a running total and returns 0; it returns 2 on a short write and 1 when the earlier check passes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B8A4
name: flush_state_buffer_once
description: Calls a helper with the state block's buffer and the value one, returning nothing. It is a fixed-argument call into the output path.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B8B4
name: allocate_sequence_table_block
description: Allocates a block of 7728 bytes and, when it succeeds, sets three internal pointers into it at fixed offsets. It returns true when the allocation failed.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B8CA
name: reset_sequence_table_pointers
description: Recomputes the same three internal pointers from the stored block base and returns 0.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:B8E6
name: free_sequence_table_block
description: Frees the 7728-byte block when it is set and clears its pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:BCAC
name: build_slot_lookup_table_once
description: Builds a 512-entry lookup table on first use, starting with four direct entries and then filling runs whose length doubles at each step, and sets a built flag so this happens only once.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:BCF4
name: fill_slot_lookup_remainder
description: Continues filling the same 512-entry slot lookup table with runs whose length doubles at each step, writing slot numbers until the table is full.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:BD14
name: fill_slot_lookup_alternate_runs
description: Fills the rest of the slot lookup table in alternating runs, with the second run of each pair one step above the first, until 512 entries are written.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:C596
name: allocate_zeroed_tree_arrays
description: Allocates a block sized from the count, eight bytes per entry plus two, zeroes its first eight bytes per entry, and stores four pointers into it at fixed offsets. It returns 1 if the allocation fails and 0 on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:C5BC
name: zero_and_set_tree_arrays
description: Zeroes the first eight bytes per entry of a caller-supplied block and sets the same four pointers into it. It returns 0.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:C5C8
name: fill_block_and_set_pointers
description: Fills a block with a given byte value for a stated length, then sets four pointers into it at fixed offsets derived from the entry count. It returns 0.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:C606
name: free_tree_arrays
description: Frees the tree-array block when it is set, using a size derived from the entry count, then clears the block pointer and the three pointers into it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:C874
name: format_text_via_rawdofmt
description: Calls the library formatting routine with arguments the caller has set up, returning nothing. It builds text for output.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:C898
name: format_text_from_caller_args
description: Calls the library formatting routine in the same way, using arguments prepared by the caller, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:C8BE
name: store_formatted_byte_at_pointer
description: Stores one byte at the destination pointer and returns nothing. It is referenced as the per-character output callback for the formatting routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:D544
name: update_crc32_over_buffer
description: Updates a running 32-bit checksum over a block of bytes using a 256-entry table in the state block, processing groups of sixteen bytes before the remainder. It stores the running value and returns its complement.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:D63E
name: checksum_in_megabyte_chunks
description: Starts a checksum by resetting the running value and returning 0 when no buffer is given. Otherwise it feeds the data to a checksum helper in chunks of 1048576 bytes and returns the result for the final partial chunk.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:D65A
name: feed_data_in_megabyte_chunks
description: Passes a block of data to a helper in chunks of 1048576 bytes, with the last partial chunk sent through a second helper. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:D66C
name: feed_remainder_in_megabyte_chunks
description: Processes a block of data in chunks of 1048576 bytes, one helper call per chunk, then makes a final call for any remainder. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E420
name: build_canonical_huffman_table
description: Counts how often each code length occurs, computes starting code offsets, and fills the decoding table with canonical codes, falling back to a helper when the counts are invalid. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through the table fill, so the end of the routine is not recovered.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E6C0
name: run_handler_table_until_null
description: Walks a table of handler function pointers held in the state block, calling each one until it reaches a null entry, then sets a done flag. It returns the last handler result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E6C6
name: run_handler_table_do_loop
description: Walks a table of handler function pointers in the state block, calling each one when the done flag is set or no result exists yet, until a null entry is reached. It then sets the done flag.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E6F4
name: call_indirect_handler_return_constant
description: Calls a handler through a function pointer held in a global, passing the address of a global variable, then returns the constant twenty. The handler is not named in the executable.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E716
name: invoke_global_callback
description: Calls a handler through a function pointer held in a global, passing the address of a global variable, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E7D8
name: compare_case_insensitive_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings letter by letter, folding lowercase letters to upper case, and returns the difference at the first mismatch or zero when they are equal.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E81C
name: parse_signed_integer
description: Reads an optional plus or minus sign and then decimal digits from the string, storing the signed value at the given location. It returns the number of characters consumed.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E868
name: convert_string_to_lower_case
description: Converts each uppercase letter in the zero-terminated string to lower case in place, using a character class table, and returns the original pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E874
name: lower_case_string_in_place
description: Lowers the case of each uppercase letter in the zero-terminated string at the given pointer, in place, using the same character class table. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E88E
name: copy_string_lowering_case
description: Writes the given first character at the destination, then copies the rest of the source string while lowering uppercase letters, stopping at the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E8A0
name: upper_case_string_in_place
description: Converts each lowercase letter in the zero-terminated string to upper case in place, using the character class table, and returns the original pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E8AC
name: make_string_upper_case
description: Converts each lowercase letter in the zero-terminated string at the pointer to upper case in place, using the character class table. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E8C6
name: copy_string_uppercasing_from_char
description: Writes the given first character at the destination, then copies the rest of the source string while raising lowercase letters to upper case, stopping at the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E8D8
name: free_pending_node_list
description: Walks a list of pending nodes, releasing each node's memory, and before the final node reports through a helper when a configuration field is above 35. It runs until the list is empty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E8DE
name: free_pending_node_list_do
description: Releases the pending node list in the same way as its neighbour, using a do-while loop that frees each node and checks the same configuration field before the last one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E948
name: teardown_state_and_return
description: Records the given value, runs an optional cleanup callback, releases buffers and library handles held in the state block, and returns the recorded value. It is the teardown path for the program.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:E950
name: parse_command_line_into_array
description: Splits a command string into words, honouring quoted text and asterisk escapes for escape and newline characters. It counts the words, allocates an array of pointers for them with the memory allocator, and fills it with the word starts.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:EAB4
name: free_argument_array_if_set
description: Frees the argument array from the parser when both its pointer and its count are set, then returns the stored count.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:EAD8
name: compare_strings_up_to_length
description: Compares up to a given number of characters of two strings as signed bytes. It returns minus one or one at the first difference, depending on which character is smaller, and zero when the strings match over that length.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:EAFC
name: return_sign_from_comparison
description: Converts the processor flags left by an earlier comparison into a result of minus one or one. It reads the flags, not arguments, so it depends on the caller's comparison.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:EB08
name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Finds the terminator of the destination buffer and copies the source string onto its end, including the terminator. It returns the original destination pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:EB20
name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies up to a given number of bytes from the source string, stopping after its terminator, and zero-fills the rest of the destination up to that count. It returns the destination pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:EB30
name: copy_string_and_pad_zeros
description: Copies a zero-terminated string to the destination and then writes zero bytes for the rest of the given count. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:EB3A
name: zero_fill_block
description: Writes zero bytes to the destination for the given count and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:EB44
name: check_char_class_then_call
description: Checks a string's characters against a flag in the character class table and then calls a helper. The returned value comes from a local that the pseudo-code never sets, so the result is not recovered.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:EB78
name: run_shutdown_hooks_then_call
description: Walks a list of registered hook records in the state block, calling the function stored in each record, then passes its argument to a helper.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:EB7C
name: run_registered_hooks_then_release
description: Calls the function stored in each registered hook record, then makes one further helper call with no arguments. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:EBC6
name: release_chained_blocks_to_bound
description: Releases memory blocks from a chain held in the state block, stopping when the chain reaches the bound passed in. It saves the caller's register values before the loop and returns them as a pair afterwards.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:EC50
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper with no arguments and returns nothing. It is a thin wrapper around that call.
